name: Animal Shelter
special: Daily Free "Surprise" (Animal Pack)

name: Arcade
special: The Arcade has an interesting function where you can spin for a chance to win animals, Utopium, houses, trees and decor. The first spin each day is free while subsequent spins cost start from 500,000 up to 10,000,000 coins (depending on expansion level). Unique items that can be found are: an astrotree (Utopium Blossom), several astroglass decorations, three astroglass residential types and special Animal Packs. Animal packs can contain between 1 and 4 animals.

name: Bank
special: Fully occupied buildings now produce twice as many coins

name: Building Firm
special: Existing buildings can now be replicated and empty duplicate buildings can be deleted. The first of any kind of building can never be deleted

name: Astro Church
special: REMOVED

name: Construction Yard
special: Roads available for construction.

name: Court
special: Access Gallery

name: Enterprise
special: The button in this building allows you to purchase a onetime upgrade (for real cash) that doubles the working time of every building.

name: Farm
special: Bumper Season: The Farm uses stockpiled Hearts to double all building multipliers for an overall double in CPS for a limited time.

name: Financial Center
special: View total CPS and other financial stats

name: Gene Pool
special: REMOVED

name: Greenhouse
special: Unlocks Grass Terrain

name: Hotel
special: Lets you temporarily store clones. See Vacationing

name: IT Services
special: Unlocks the building Upgrade function

name: Lake
special: You may now build waterways in your town from the landscape menu.

name: Law Firm
special: Legal loopholes create an alternate way to level up and expand. Cost: 40u

name: Library
special: REMOVED

name: Utopium Mine
special: The Utopium Mine will allow you harvest a free 1u - 2u per day. This building can be upgraded to a Newtopium Mine at the cost of real money.

name: Museum
special: In the 1.80 update, the Museum got a special ability. Now there are a few special missions that can only be completed at the Museum. Once you complete a mission, you need to wait until midnight before you can start the next mission. There are 9 of them resulting in completing the First Wonder:

name: News Bureau
special: Enable or disable the Live Newsfeed from here

name: Nursery
special: The Nursery building unlocks the ability of building Trees. Each "normal" tree costs 1 utopium (excluding the Astroglass tree). Besides this, the Nursery also provides trees which will spread near your Roads.

name: Observatory
special: Change background

name: Ad Agency
special: REMOVED

name: Park
special: Decor construction is now available in the landscape menu

name: Photo Studio
special: REMOVED

name: Police Station
special: Clicking the building gives access to the achievements button which leads you to a list of all the achievements that you can, and have, earned as well as collecting the free bonus utopium for completeing them

name: Post Office
special: The Post Office shows the email address where you can ask for support. It shows: support (at) lambdamugames (dot) com

name: Radio Station
special: REMOVED

name: Research Facility
special: The Research Lab building gives the option of permanently reducing the number of hearts required for surprises by 1 at an increasing cost of Utopium per upgrade. While the first upgrades cost 10, 20 and 30 Utopium per heart, the next upgrades will cost 50, 70, 90 and 120 Utopium. When researched all of them, you'll only need 4 hearts for every special delivery.

name: Sheriffs Office
special: Sheriff's Office is a type of building. Allows access to the developer credits in the form of a mugs-gallery

name: SpacePort
special: Duh~!

name: Theatre
special: REMOVED

name: Town Hall
special: The Town Hall has three useful buttons not found in other profession buildings: hints, shop (currency exchange), and notifications

name: TV Station
special: The TV Station has a special function in Utopia. Upon pressing 'Enter' you are taken to a list where you can view advertisements of third parties. Successfully complete one of the offers, and you'll be rewarded with Utopium.

name: School of Magic
special: Unlocks the building Flip function

name: Fortune Teller
special: Everyday the Fortune Teller will make a Daily Divination, in which it gives the combination for a (new) gene.

name: Altar
special: As of version 1.50, the Altar can be used to mutate a person to increase the person's productivity forever. Each mutation costs 1 Mutopium (upgrade the person from 1 cps to 2 cps) or 2 Mutopium (from 2 cps to 3 cps).

name: Dating Agency
special: The Switch in the detailed view allows you to swap between the animation of coins being produced by your buildings and replacing them with hearts. This is an entirely cosmetic change♥

name: MissionControl
special: Missions are unlocked

name: Casino
special: There are 2 types of spins. The Normal or Regular Spin and the VIP Spin. Every Normal Spin costs 2 million coins and there is a chance to win between 3mil and 80mil coins. Of course the chances to win 80mil are much smaller than the chances to win 3mil coins. The Normal Spin has a cool down of 4 hours. The VIP Spin costs the player real money. With the same odds to win as the Normal Spin, the winnings can be between 25 utopium and 500 utopium. There is no cool down on the VIP Spin.

name: ConcertHall
special: When the Concert Hall is constructed (after splicing one of the required musician-related professions), a new musical score for Pixel People will be unlocked and can be heard as background music in addition to the two original tracks.

name: Tech Park
special: BLOCKED

name: Baseball Diamond
special: The Ballpark has a "switch" button that rounds the cash display, shortening the display to a 'ballpark' figure. It rounds your cash to the nearest thousand or million. Please note that "Rough Estimates" will always cap at 2147m, regardless of how many coins you actually have.

name: Broadcast Station
special: Ability to hide idle News button

name: Lumber Mill
special: At the Lumber Mill the player can trigger the event Over Logging at the cost of coins. This event raises the daily Utopium harvesting limit from 25 to 50 Utopium. Event lasts till the day ends (12PM).

name: Chemical Plant
special: The event Utopium Leak can only be triggered at the Chemical Plant. It uses stockpiled Hearts to double all output from trees for a limited time.

name: Beach House
special: Unlocks Shoreline decor

name: Carnival
special: The Funfair event can only be triggered at the Carnival and uses Stockpiled Hearts to temporarily increase your Town Spirit by a certain amount, which depends on your expansion level. Activating this event also increases the maximum discount from 50% to 60% (the amount of max spirit needed does not change). Please note that this is only the case when the event is active.

name: Secret Hideout
special: Unlocks the first batch of secret jobs

name: Ministry of Love
special: Add 10 hearts to your stockpile. Use up to 40 times per day.

name: FireworksFactory
special: At this building the event Fireworks can be triggered. It costs stockpiled hearts to activate.

name: Telephone Company
special: Allows you to deposit a gift in your city and visit other mayors' cities.

name: Pet Store
special: Exchange Utopium and Animals with friends

name: Docks
special: The Docks unlocks a nifty type of Terrain: Open Water terrain. This will allow you to build them freely in your Utopia.

name: Doomsday Clock
special: A clock counts how long you've had an active game session.

name: Beacon
special: NONE

name: Oil Rig
special: When you have built the Oil Rig you will be able to build Offshore Decor. This is a special category of decor that contains 7 new types of decor.

special: REMOVED

name: Pawn Shop
special: You can send special gifts to your friends at the Embassy. You need to be linked with Facebook and have friends who also play this game in order to be able to use this option.

name: Dark Tower
special: At the Dark Tower the player can trigger the event Cover of Darkness at the cost of 2 hearts per minute.

name: A_Rival_Center
special: More clone slots (Premium Building)
